SELECT ?ts ?point ?name WHERE {
  ?z rdfs:label "DataCenter_basement_ZN_6" .
  ?point brick:hasLocation ?z .
  ?point a brick:AirTemperatureSensor .
  ?point ref:hasTimeseriesId ?ts .
  ?point rdfs:label ?name .
}

SELECT DISTINCT ?p ?class WHERE {
  ?p a brick:AirTemperatureSensor .
  ?p brick:hasLocation ?z .
  ?z rdfs:label ?lab .
  FILTER(CONTAINS(?lab, "ZN_6"))
  ?p a ?class .
}
